components.explanation: Effect A: the LandPuff GPUParticles2D scene (emission, process material, gradient texture) and its preview fixture used for the r0 and r1 strips.
Effect B: the DomeGlints GPUParticles2D scene (box emission, preprocess, additive CanvasItemMaterial) and its preview fixture.
The presentation-only effects driver (a puff per landing on the SFX-LAND condition; glints off at WON, restart on replay) and the one session.gd line (63) that adds it.
Godot's Convert to ShaderMaterial output for LandPuff's process material, saved unedited, not used by the game.
The two config tests, the two state tests, and the read-only route planner the Effect B state test and the film's capture reuse.
The headless cost script, the separate lifecycle peak checker, and project.godot (the Compatibility renderer).

code_result_pairs.observation: Strip r0 (fixture): at frame 12 the crumbs show on plate and table; at frame 15 most are still under the jellies with no wide fan; frames 20, 30 and 50 are empty (Kiran's r0 verdict, TUNING.md).
Strip r1 against r0 (fixture): at frame 12 crumbs are about 5–15 px past both jelly edges and at frame 15 up to 36–49 px, beyond Claude's predicted 40 px (TUNING.md, session-4d-comparison.md).

In the scripted capture, a puff appears at the jelly's feet on each landing tick (313, 449, 458, 558, 698, 774, 883, 950, 1027); the scoot-off landings are 9 ticks apart and the log shows 2 LandPuff nodes in the tree at tick 458. Visible overlap of crumbs is not claimed.
Strip r0 (fixture): glints present at frame 10, fewer at 40, no clear thinning 70→85, none at 145 (Kiran's r0 verdict, TUNING.md).
Strips r0 and r1 (fixture) at frames 10, 40 and 85: bytes differ (Kiran's cmp) but no visible difference at full size in Claude's reading; Kiran kept r1 for the in-game intro (TUNING.md).

In the scripted capture glints are on screen at tick 1; during PAUSED (ticks 1059–1180) they keep drifting; DomeGlints.emitting is false from the WON tick 1233 and the glints thin out; at the replay tick 1384 the log shows emitting true with the dome off screen.
